load_rule: Always loaded if intro map included; otherwise separate bootstrap level.
unload_rule: Unload once player commits to Land of Darkness map.
persistent_landmarks: Bedroom window glow; closet portal read
notes: Can be its own map/package if intro is detached from open-world shell.

load_rule: Load with Z03 as player approaches Friendly Tree.
unload_rule: Unload after sustained presence in hub and no return line-of-sight.
persistent_landmarks: Arrival glove, bridge, customs trap silhouette
notes: Treat as onboarding corridor with forgiving culling.

load_rule: Always loaded while in main world.
persistent_landmarks: House trunk silhouette, lift basket, path forks
notes: Primary orientation anchor; safest place to pin world-partition origin.

load_rule: Load from Z03 and keep resident with adjacent river branches.
unload_rule: Can unload when deep inside house or mines and no water audio bleed desired.
persistent_landmarks: Dock, opposite shore log, branching river read
notes: Good candidate for a medium persistent cell because of travel frequency.

load_rule: Load when player commits inland from the opposite shore.
unload_rule: Unload when player returns to river core and loses audio/visual contact.
persistent_landmarks: Well ring, flower patch, vegetable beds
notes: Bottom of well can be subcell or kept within same zone.

load_rule: Load from river core as player nears toll bridge.
unload_rule: Unload once player exits back to river core or leaves branch entirely.
persistent_landmarks: Toll bridge profile, open park clearing
notes: Shallow branch; can be one compact stream cell.

load_rule: Load from river core on approach to shack or rapids.
unload_rule: Unload when player returns to river core and cave audio is no longer audible.
persistent_landmarks: Shack profile, waterfall noise, geyser plume
notes: Split into exterior and subterranean subcells if memory is tight.

load_rule: Load from hub mine entrance or from house service door side.
unload_rule: Hold briefly after exit to preserve rapid backtracking.
persistent_landmarks: King station, water meter, service door
notes: Keep ambient reverb distinct from lower mines.

load_rule: Load from Z08 when player commits deeper than first junction.
unload_rule: Unload after return to upper mines and no lower-loop audio/visibility remains.
persistent_landmarks: Gold pocket, terminal, secret branch silhouettes
notes: This is the most compressible stream zone.

zone_name: House Platform and Lower Domestic Floor
load_rule: Load with Z03 when player is on lift, and keep warm while near house exterior.
unload_rule: Unload only after player is well inside Z11/Z12 or far back in world exterior.
persistent_landmarks: Lift top reveal, entry hall, kitchen/living-room split
notes: Best handled by portal volumes or floor-based level instances.

zone_name: House Mid Stack and Service Spine
load_rule: Load as player leaves Doors of Knowledge region or enters lower service branch.
unload_rule: Hold while player is anywhere in upper or lower house interiors.
persistent_landmarks: Weird hall, organ room, bookcase passage, lab glow
notes: Critical interior streaming zone because it bridges house and mines.

load_rule: Load one stair-flight before bedroom landing.
unload_rule: Unload after player returns to lower stack and bedroom sightline is broken.
persistent_landmarks: Bedroom landing, Darkness’s bedroom, closet silhouette
notes: Quietest acoustic zone; minimal prop density compared with mid house.
